title: why mmseqs gives nail no seed for 88 single-domain decoys that hmmer scores up to 34 bits
body: All 88 single-domain decoys in reports/pid-2026-09-24/singles.tbl that nail missed outright had no seed from mmseqs. decoys.tbl records how nail reached each of the top 500: search 100, one-by-one at search settings 255, one-by-one with every filter open 7, synthetic seed 88, never 50. For mmseqs: search 124, one-by-one 251, never 125.
